JUDGEMENT CALL: printed no women's league-phase table position, because inter.it's standings page had not updated after matchday 4 (it still listed Manchester City on three points after they had won 4-1), so only 'four points from four matches' ran, which is arithmetic on published results. Scoreboard LAST carries the women's 1-4 while the LATEST RESULT section keeps the men's 2-0 Como, as the schema requires. Operational notes: inter.it served stale copy twice this morning (the Italian news index and the match report both came back as '0-0 LIVE' until ?cb= was added), and sport.sky.it/calcio/serie-a/squadre/inter returned a client error and could not be read, so Gazzetta and Corriere dello Sport were reached through the FCInterNews rassegna instead.
